{{Disambig|Monster}}

==Enemies==
'''Monster''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Nuclear Monster]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 25 in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]

'''Monster''' may also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Swamp Monster]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 12 in [[Foggy Forest|Night II]] of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]

==Units==
'''Monster''' may refer to these units:
*[[Monster]], an unused unit that can only be spawned via admin commands
*[[Molten Monster]], a unit that is spawned by the consumable of the same name and the final wave of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]

==Merchandise==
'''Monster''' may refer to these pieces of merchandise:
*[[Nuclear Monster Mini Plush]]

==Other==
